decisions.reason: The source changes label content and hover behavior but does not change the requirement that interface text and interactive-field labels be Danish.
The source describes persistent hover help after users replace field content; it does not change whether a placeholder clears when the field is activated.
Persistent help labels do not alter the requirement that fields remain unique and avoid duplicating content across fields.
The hover label explains a field's intended content after replacement but does not resolve or change the required visible cue identifying editable fields.
The label rule does not change the selected editable-text representation or its architecture-quality requirement.
The source changes help-label behavior and does not affect retention of Title-field formatting when content is replaced.
The source does not alter the calendar-dropdown selection method for date fields.
The help-label rule does not enable, disable, or otherwise modify the board-meeting dropdown control.
The source does not change the checklist control's type or enabled status.
The source concerns interactive-field help labels, not manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source does not change the legacy-content transfer workflow or its layout and style stability expectations.
The source does not affect pasted-table layout stability or containment of columns within page margins.
